assumptions.text: Environment terms (storage before the transaction, block, msg and tx members, blobhash, results of external calls, sload) are free: every value of them is possible.
Implicit reverts (checked arithmetic, array bounds, ABI decoding, failing external calls) are not guards: only explicit require, assert and revert (and Yul revert/invalid) are.

A loop body is walked once at a generic iteration: what it changes is a phi term of the loop (locals, storage families, memory regions), a guard inside it holds at every iteration, and its cost term counts the header's bound.
External calls do not change this contract's storage (no reentrancy): a storage read after an external call is the value this contract last wrote, or the value before the transaction.
One guard per span: a require or revert reached again (a second inlined call of the same function) keeps the expression of its first reach.

target.scope: rollup contract: storage families, transitions of every external/public function, cost terms, principal predicates, hash/commit edges, coverage
